结果已经明确了一半：

CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL：当前 Kconfig 整段缺失，upstream 有完整配置，因此 .config 无法生成该值。
sys_startup_fn()：两个 esp_start.c 完全相同；但当前版本缺少 upstream 中声明该函数的 esp_start.h，所以出现隐式声明。

还需确认 Kconfig 插入位置，以及 upstream 如何包含 esp_start.h。执行下面的只读命令：

cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx

echo "=== 当前 Kconfig 330-430 ==="
sed -n '330,430p' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

echo "=== upstream Kconfig 330-430 ==="
sed -n '330,430p' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

echo "=== Kconfig 局部差异 ==="
diff -u \
  <(sed -n '320,440p' arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig) \
  <(sed -n '320,440p' ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig) \
  | sed -n '1,260p'

echo "=== esp_start.c 文件头 ==="
sed -n '20,70p' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.c

echo "=== upstream esp_start.c 文件头 ==="
sed -n '20,70p' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.c

echo "=== esp_start.h 是否存在 ==="
ls -l \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  2>&1

echo "=== 谁包含 esp_start.h ==="
grep -Rns --include='*.c' --include='*.h' --include='Make.defs' \
  'esp_start.h' \
  arch/risc-v/src \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src 2>/dev/null \
  | sed -n '1,100p'

暂时不要直接在 .config 里写：

CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL=0

因为它会在重新配置时丢失。正确做法应是恢复 upstream 的 Kconfig 配置块，让 olddefconfig 自动生成；sys_startup_fn() 也优先恢复 upstream 的正式头文件声明，而不是随手在 .c 中增加声明。

文档
思考了 25s

现在可以确认：

esp_start.c 已正确包含 esp_start.h。
当前 esp_start.h 是旧版本，缺少 sys_startup_fn() 声明。
CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL 整个配置块确实没有进入当前 Kconfig。
当前和 upstream 的 Kconfig 排列差异很大，不能直接按 upstream 行号复制，否则可能再次破坏菜单结构。

再做最后一次只读定位：

cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx

echo "=== esp_start.h 完整差异 ==="
diff -u \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  | sed -n '1,240p'

echo "=== 当前 Kconfig 菜单结构及关键配置 ==="
grep -nE \
  '^menu |^endmenu|^config ESPRESSIF_(SIMPLE_BOOT|BOOTLOADER|CPU_FREQ|MAX_CPU_FREQ|MIN_CPU_FREQ|LOG_LEVEL)' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  | sed -n '1,260p'

echo "=== upstream Kconfig 菜单结构及关键配置 ==="
grep -nE \
  '^menu |^endmenu|^config ESPRESSIF_(SIMPLE_BOOT|BOOTLOADER|CPU_FREQ|MAX_CPU_FREQ|MIN_CPU_FREQ|LOG_LEVEL)' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  | sed -n '1,260p'

echo "=== 当前 SIMPLE_BOOT 附近 ==="
grep -n -B15 -A30 \
  '^config ESPRESSIF_SIMPLE_BOOT' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

echo "=== 当前第一个外设配置前后 ==="
grep -n -B12 -A12 \
  '^config ESPRESSIF_TWAI0' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

完成这一步后，修复应当是：

从 upstream 精确移植 esp_start.h 中缺少的函数声明；
将官方 Espressif Log Level 配置块插入当前 Kconfig 的正确菜单边界；
执行 make olddefconfig，由 Kconfig 自动生成 CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL=0；
再清理编译。

不会直接硬编码 .config，也不会整份覆盖当前 openvela 的 Kconfig。

粘贴的文本 (1)(20260809-051756).txt
文档
思考了 1m 9s

现在证据充分，可以做两个精确移植：

esp_start.h 与 upstream 只有 SPDX 和 sys_startup_fn() 声明不同，因此可直接同步该头文件。
Log Level 配置块应插在当前 Bootloader and Image Configuration 菜单之前，位置与 upstream 一致。

先同步头文件：

cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx

cp \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h

再提取并插入 upstream 的官方 Log Level 配置块：

P4_LOG_BLOCK=/tmp/esp32p4_log_level.kconfig

sed -n \
  '/^menu "Espressif Log Level"$/,/^endmenu # Espressif Log Level$/p' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  > "$P4_LOG_BLOCK"

wc -l "$P4_LOG_BLOCK"

P4_BOOT_LINE=$(grep -n \
  '^menu "Bootloader and Image Configuration"$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)

echo "Bootloader menu line: $P4_BOOT_LINE"

sed -i \
  "$((P4_BOOT_LINE - 1))r $P4_LOG_BLOCK" \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

确认没有重复插入：

grep -c '^menu "Espressif Log Level"$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

grep -c '^config ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

grep -n -B3 -A5 '^config ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

git diff --check

前两个计数都必须为 1。

然后让 Kconfig 自动生成配置：

make olddefconfig

验证：

grep -E \
  '^CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL(_NONE)?=' \
  .config

grep -E \
  '^#define CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL(_NONE)? ' \
  include/nuttx/config.h

L0 无调试日志配置下，预计得到：

CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL_NONE=y
CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL=0

最后重新构建：

make clean

make -j2 2>&1 \
  | tee ~/openvela-work/logs/contest284_esp32p4_build11.log

接下来如何验证最小NCS

按上下文，“NCS”应为 **NSH**。

当前状态：

- `build24` 已成功，`nuttx.bin` 镜像校验有效。
- 还不能判定 L0 通过，因为当前环境没有 `/dev/ttyACM*` 或 `/dev/ttyUSB*`，尚未完成实板启动。
- 官方标准是：烧录后串口出现 `NuttShell (NSH)` 和 `nsh>`，才算 L0 成功。[最小 NSH 基线](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/hardware_porting/defconfig_reference/minimum_nsh_baseline.md)

**实板验证**

1. 连接端口：
   - 烧录口：`/dev/ttyACM0`
   - UART0 控制台：`/dev/ttyUSB0`
   - 波特率：115200
   - UART 引脚：GPIO37 TX、GPIO38 RX

2. 先打开控制台：

```bash
picocom -b 115200 /dev/ttyUSB0
```

3. 另开终端烧录：

```bash
cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx
source ~/venvs/esp-tools/bin/activate

make flash \
  ESPTOOL_PORT=/dev/ttyACM0 \
  ESPTOOL_BINDIR=./
```

若无法进入下载模式，按住 `BOOT`，点按 `RESET`，再释放 `BOOT`。

4. 看到 `nsh>` 后依次运行：

```text
help
uname -a
ps
free
uptime
sleep 1
uptime
```

5. 通过条件：
   - UART 收发正常。
   - `help`、`uname`、`ps`、`free` 返回正常。
   - 两次 `uptime` 持续增长，验证 SYSTIMER/IRQ/tick。
   - `sleep 1` 能返回提示符。
   - 冷启动三次均能进入 `nsh>`，无 panic、异常或重复复位。

当前 defconfig 仍有 `FS_PROCFS`、`TESTING_GETPRIME`、`TESTING_OSTEST` 三项非最小内容；最终提交前应只删除这三项并重建，不扩展网络、文件系统或其他外设。

+ * Name: recalib_bbpll
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Workaround for bootloader calibration issues. This function is placed in
+ *   IRAM because disabling BBPLL may influence the cache.
+ *
+ * Input Parameters:
+ *   None.
+ *
+ * Returned Value:
+ *   None.

+
+#if defined(CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ESP32C6) || defined(CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ESP32H2)
+static void IRAM_ATTR NOINLINE_ATTR recalib_bbpll(void)
+{
+    rtc_cpu_freq_config_t old_config;
+    rtc_clk_cpu_freq_get_config(&old_config);
+
+  if (old_config.source == SOC_CPU_CLK_SRC_PLL
+#ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ESP32H2
+      || old_config.source == SOC_CPU_CLK_SRC_FLASH_PLL
+#endif
+      )
+    {
+      rtc_clk_cpu_freq_set_xtal();
+      rtc_clk_cpu_freq_set_config(&old_config);

只读结论：

- 复位源由 NuttX 调用的 `bootloader_init()` 创建，不是 NSH 配置：`bootloader_config_wdt()` 根据 `CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_WDT_ENABLE=1` 启动 9000 ms LP/RWDT，超时动作为 `RESET_RTC`。
- 当前 `esp_start.c` 与 upstream 完全相同，并在 MMU、RTC、MSPI、时钟、串口初始化完成后、`nx_start()` 前显式关闭 RWDT。
- board boot 为空实现，当前 MWDT/RWDT 驱动配置均关闭，没有其他喂狗逻辑。
- 当前 HAL pin 与 upstream 都是 `8d0a898...`。实际链接的是直接寄存器实现 `wdt_hal_iram.c`，不是 ROM patch，因此 ECO7 ROM 的 WDT patch 差异不是本次已证实根因。
- 旧的成功串口日志同样存在 SHA 比较失败和 7 个 segment，最终进入了 `nsh>`；这两个现象本身不是阻塞证据。
- 截图最后输出位于 `map_rom_segments()` 的段枚举结束处，但此后没有可见 checkpoint。LP WDT 只说明后续路径未在超时前完成，不能证明具体卡在 MMU，也不能证明 startup hook 已执行。

因此应先烧录 **build26**，不再改代码，也暂不同时裁配置，保持单变量验证。build26 若进入 `nsh>`，再只裁掉三项非最小配置并构建最终镜像。若仍在相同位置复位，下一步只加 ROM checkpoint，依次定位：

1. `map_rom_segments()` 返回；
2. region protection；
3. `esp_rtc_init()` / MSPI / MMU；
4. clock / peripheral clock；
5. RWDT 关闭前后。

不建议现在提前移动或永久禁用 WDT，那会掩盖真实启动卡点。

    68	static void bootloader_check_wdt_reset(void)
    69	{
    70	    int wdt_rst = 0;
    71	    soc_reset_reason_t rst_reason = esp_rom_get_reset_reason(0);
    72	    if (rst_reason == RESET_REASON_CPU_MWDT || rst_reason == RESET_REASON_CPU_RWDT || rst_reason == RESET_REASON_CORE_MWDT ||
    73	        rst_reason == RESET_REASON_CORE_RWDT || rst_reason == RESET_REASON_SYS_RWDT) {
    74	        ESP_LOGW(TAG, "CPU has been reset by WDT.");
    75	        wdt_rst = 1;
    76	    }
    77	    if (wdt_rst) {
    78	        // if reset by WDT dump info from trace port
    79	        wdt_reset_info_dump(0);
    80	#if !CONFIG_ESP_SYSTEM_SINGLE_CORE_MODE
    81	        wdt_reset_info_dump(1);
    82	#endif
    83	    }
    84	    wdt_reset_cpu0_info_enable();
    85	}

    88	{

    90	    REG_SET_BIT(LP_WDT_SWD_CONFIG_REG, LP_WDT_SWD_AUTO_FEED_EN);

    94	static inline void bootloader_hardware_init(void)
    95	{
    96	    _regi2c_ctrl_ll_master_enable_clock(true); // keep ana i2c mst clock always enabled in bootloader
    97	    regi2c_ctrl_ll_master_configure_clock();
    98	
    99	    unsigned chip_version = efuse_hal_chip_revision();
   100	    if (!ESP_CHIP_REV_ABOVE(chip_version, 1)) {
   101	        // On ESP32P4 ECO0, the default (power on reset) CPLL and SPLL frequencies are very high, lower them to avoid bias may not be enough in bootloader
   102	        // And we are fixing SPLL to be 480MHz after app is up
   103	        REGI2C_WRITE_MASK(I2C_CPLL, I2C_CPLL_OC_DIV_7_0, 6); // lower default cpu_pll freq to 400M
   104	        REGI2C_WRITE_MASK(I2C_SYSPLL, I2C_SYSPLL_OC_DIV_7_0, 8); // lower default sys_pll freq to 480M
   105	        esp_rom_delay_us(100);
   106	    }
   107	    REGI2C_WRITE_MASK(I2C_BIAS, I2C_BIAS_DREG_1P1, 10);
   108	    REGI2C_WRITE_MASK(I2C_BIAS, I2C_BIAS_DREG_1P1_PVT, 10);
   109	
   110	#if !CONFIG_APP_BUILD_TYPE_PURE_RAM_APP
   111	    // IDF-10019 TODO: This is temporarily for ESP32P4-ECO0, please remove it when eco0 is not widly used.
   112	    if (likely(ESP_CHIP_REV_ABOVE(chip_version, 1))) {
   113	        bootloader_init_mspi_clock();
   114	    }
   115	#endif
   116	}

   126	esp_err_t bootloader_init(void)
   127	{
   128	    esp_err_t ret = ESP_OK;
   129	
   130	    bootloader_hardware_init();
   131	    bootloader_ana_reset_config();
   132	    bootloader_super_wdt_auto_feed();
   133	
   134	// In RAM_APP, memory will be initialized in `call_start_cpu0`
   135	#if !CONFIG_APP_BUILD_TYPE_RAM
   136	    // protect memory region
   137	    bootloader_init_mem();
   138	    /* check that static RAM is after the stack */
   139	    assert(&_bss_start <= &_bss_end);
   140	    assert(&_data_start <= &_data_end);
   141	    // clear bss section
   142	    bootloader_clear_bss_section();
   143	#endif // !CONFIG_APP_BUILD_TYPE_RAM
   144	
   145	    // init eFuse virtual mode (read eFuses to RAM)
   146	#ifdef CONFIG_EFUSE_VIRTUAL
   147	    ESP_EARLY_LOGW(TAG, "eFuse virtual mode is enabled. If Secure boot or Flash encryption is enabled then it does not provide any security. FOR TESTING ONLY!");
   148	#ifndef CONFIG_EFUSE_VIRTUAL_KEEP_IN_FLASH
   149	    esp_efuse_init_virtual_mode_in_ram();
   150	#endif
   151	#endif
   152	
   153	    // config clock
   154	    bootloader_clock_configure();
   155	    // initialize console, from now on, we can use esp_log
   156	    bootloader_console_init();
   157	    /* print 2nd bootloader banner */
   158	    bootloader_print_banner();
   159	
   160	#if !CONFIG_APP_BUILD_TYPE_RAM
   161	    // init cache and mmu
   162	    bootloader_init_ext_mem();
   163	    // update flash ID
   164	    bootloader_flash_update_id();
   165	    // Check and run XMC startup flow
   166	    if ((ret = bootloader_flash_xmc_startup()) != ESP_OK) {
   167	        ESP_LOGE(TAG, "failed when running XMC startup flow, reboot!");
   168	        return ret;
   169	    }
   170	    // read bootloader header
   171	    if ((ret = bootloader_read_bootloader_header()) != ESP_OK) {
   172	        return ret;
   173	    }
   174	    // read chip revision and check if it's compatible to bootloader
   175	    if ((ret = bootloader_check_bootloader_validity()) != ESP_OK) {
   176	        return ret;
   177	    }
   178	    // initialize spi flash
   179	    if ((ret = bootloader_init_spi_flash()) != ESP_OK) {
   180	        return ret;
   181	    }
   182	#endif // !CONFIG_APP_BUILD_TYPE_RAM
   183	
   184	    // check whether a WDT reset happened
   185	    bootloader_check_wdt_reset();
   186	    // config WDT
   187	    bootloader_config_wdt();
   188	    // enable RNG early entropy source
   189	    bootloader_enable_random();
   190	
   191	    return ret;
   192	}

   182	 * Name: esp_isr_demultiplexing
   183	 *
   184	 * Description:
   185	 *   Demultiplexing interrupt handler. All peripheral interrupts are
   186	 *   dispatched through this single handler, which then calls the
   187	 *   appropriate peripheral handler registered via esp_setup_irq.

   189	 * Input Parameters:
   190	 *   irq     - The IRQ number (XTENSA_IRQ_DEMUX)
   191	 *   context - Saved processor state

   199	IRAM_ATTR static int esp_isr_demultiplexing(int irq, void *context,
   200	                                            void *arg)

   204	  struct intr_adapter_from_nuttx *handler_arg;

   206	  /* Validate cpuint - if invalid, the interrupt was not properly
   207	   * registered via esp_setup_irq. This is a bug that needs to be fixed.

   210	  if (cpuint < 0 || cpuint >= SOC_CPU_INTR_NUM)
   211	    {
   212	      irqwarn("IRQ %d has invalid cpuint=%d (not registered)", irq, cpuint);
   213	      return OK;
   214	    }
   215	
   216	  handler = (intr_handler_t)esp_cpu_intr_get_handler(cpuint);
   217	  handler_arg = (struct intr_adapter_from_nuttx *)
   218	                  esp_cpu_intr_get_handler_arg(cpuint);

   220	  /* If the handler is the isr_adapter_func, then we need to set the irq
   221	   * and context to the handler_arg. This is true for all interrupts set via
   222	   * esp_setup_irq. Exceptions are the interrupts set directly by the
   223	   * underlying hardware, like Wi-Fi.
   224	   */
   225	
   226	  if (handler == &isr_adapter_func)
   227	    {
   228	      handler_arg->irq = irq;
   229	      handler_arg->context = context;
   230	    }
   231	
   232	  if (handler)
   233	    {
   234	      (*handler)(handler_arg);
   235	    }

   237	    {
   238	      /* Handler not found in _xt_interrupt_table.
   239	       * This happens when irq_attach was used instead of esp_setup_irq

   241	       * esp_setup_irq() when using ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE.
   242	       */
   243	
   244	      irqwarn("No handler for irq=%d cpuint=%d\n", irq, cpuint);
   245	    }

   248	}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: riscv_exception
 *
 * Description:
 *   This is the exception handler.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

int riscv_exception(int mcause, void *regs, void *args)
{
#ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_KERNEL_STACK
  struct tcb_s *tcb = this_task();
#endif
  uintreg_t cause = mcause & RISCV_IRQ_MASK;

  _alert("EXCEPTION: %s. MCAUSE: %" PRIxREG ", EPC: %" PRIxREG
         ", MTVAL: %" PRIxREG "\n",
         mcause > RISCV_MAX_EXCEPTION ? "Unknown" : g_reasons_str[cause],
         cause, READ_CSR(CSR_EPC), READ_CSR(CSR_TVAL));

#ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_KERNEL_STACK
  if ((atomic_read(&tcb->flags) & TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_MASK) !=
      TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL)
    {
      _alert("Segmentation fault in PID %d: %s\n",
             tcb->pid, get_task_name(tcb));

      atomic_or(&tcb->flags, TCB_FLAG_FORCED_CANCEL);

      /* Return to _exit function in privileged mode with argument SIGSEGV */

      running_regs()[REG_EPC] = _exit;
      running_regs()[REG_A0] = (void *)SIGSEGV;
      ((uintreg_t *)running_regs())[REG_INT_CTX] |= STATUS_PPP;

      /* Continue with kernel stack in use. The frame(s) in kernel stack
       * are no longer needed, so just set it to top
       */

      running_regs()[REG_SP] = tcb->xcp.ktopstk;
    }
  else
#endif
    {
      _alert("PANIC!!! Exception = %" PRIxREG "\n", cause);
      up_irq_save();
      up_set_interrupt_context(true);
      PANIC_WITH_REGS("panic", regs);
    }

  return 0;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: riscv_fillpage
 *
 * Description:
 *   This function is an exception handler for page faults in a RISC-V.
 *   It is invoked when a page fault exception occurs, which is typically
 *   when a process tries to access a page that is not currently in memory.
 *
 *   The function takes as arguments the machine cause (mcause) which
 *   indicates the cause of the exception, a pointer to the register state
 *   at the time of the exception (regs), and a pointer to any additional
 *   arguments (args).
 *
 *   The function should handle the exception appropriately, typically by
 *   loading the required page into memory and updating the page table.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   mcause - The machine cause of the exception.
 *   regs   - A pointer to the register state at the time of the exception.
 *   args   - A pointer to any additional arguments.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value on failure.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifdef CONFIG_PAGING
int riscv_fillpage(int mcause, void *regs, void *args)
{
  uintptr_t cause = mcause & RISCV_IRQ_MASK;
  uintptr_t ptlast;
  uintptr_t ptprev;
  uintptr_t paddr;
  uintptr_t vaddr;
  uint32_t  ptlevel;
  uintptr_t satp;
  uint64_t  mmuflags;

  _info("EXCEPTION: %s. MCAUSE: %" PRIxREG ", EPC: %" PRIxREG
        ", MTVAL: %" PRIxREG "\n",
        mcause > RISCV_MAX_EXCEPTION ? "Unknown" : g_reasons_str[cause],
        cause, READ_CSR(CSR_EPC), READ_CSR(CSR_TVAL));
  vaddr = MM_PGALIGNDOWN(READ_CSR(CSR_TVAL));
  if (vaddr >= CONFIG_ARCH_TEXT_VBASE && vaddr <= ARCH_TEXT_VEND)
    {
      mmuflags = MMU_UTEXT_FLAGS;

      /* Write access to .text region needs to be set according to
       * https://github.com/apache/nuttx/pull/6193.
       */

      mmuflags |= PTE_W;
    }
  else if (vaddr >= CONFIG_ARCH_DATA_VBASE && vaddr <= ARCH_DATA_VEND)
    {
      mmuflags = MMU_UDATA_FLAGS;
    }
  else if (vaddr >= CONFIG_ARCH_HEAP_VBASE && vaddr <= ARCH_HEAP_VEND)
    {
      mmuflags = MMU_UDATA_FLAGS;
    }
  else
    {
      _alert("PANIC!!! virtual address not mappable: %" PRIxPTR "\n", vaddr);
      up_irq_save();
      up_set_interrupt_context(true);
      PANIC_WITH_REGS("panic", regs);
    }

  satp    = READ_CSR(CSR_SATP);
  ptprev  = riscv_pgvaddr(mmu_satp_to_paddr(satp));
  ptlevel = ARCH_SPGTS;
  paddr   = mmu_pte_to_paddr(mmu_ln_getentry(ptlevel, ptprev, vaddr));
  if (!paddr)
    {
      /* Nothing yet, allocate one page for final level page table */

      paddr = mm_pgalloc(1);
      if (!paddr)
        {
          return -ENOMEM;
        }

      /* Map the page table to the prior level */

      mmu_ln_setentry(ptlevel, ptprev, paddr, vaddr, MMU_UPGT_FLAGS);

      /* This is then used to map the final level */

      riscv_pgwipe(paddr);
    }

  ptlast = riscv_pgvaddr(paddr);
  paddr = mm_pgalloc(1);
  if (!paddr)
    {
      return -ENOMEM;
    }

  /* Wipe the physical page memory */

  riscv_pgwipe(paddr);

  /* Then map the virtual address to the physical address */

  mmu_ln_setentry(ptlevel + 1, ptlast, paddr, vaddr, mmuflags);

  return 0;
}
#endif /* CONFIG_PAGING */

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: riscv_exception_attach
 *
 * Description:
 *   Attach standard exception with suitable handler
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void riscv_exception_attach(void)
{
  irq_attach(RISCV_IRQ_IAMISALIGNED, riscv_exception, NULL);
  irq_attach(RISCV_IRQ_IAFAULT, riscv_exception, NULL);
  irq_attach(RISCV_IRQ_IINSTRUCTION, riscv_exception, NULL);

// --------------- Interrupt Configuration -----------------

FORCE_INLINE_ATTR void rv_utils_set_mtvec(uint32_t mtvec_val)
{
    RV_WRITE_CSR(mtvec, mtvec_val | MTVEC_MODE_CSR);
}

FORCE_INLINE_ATTR void rv_utils_set_xtvec(uint32_t xtvec_val)
{
    xtvec_val |= MTVEC_MODE_CSR; // Set MODE field to treat XTVEC as a vector base address
    if (IS_PRV_M_MODE()) {
        RV_WRITE_CSR(mtvec, xtvec_val);
    } else {
        RV_WRITE_CSR(utvec, xtvec_val);
    }
}

// ------------------ Interrupt Control --------------------

FORCE_INLINE_ATTR void rv_utils_intr_enable(uint32_t intr_mask)
{
#if CONFIG_SECURE_ENABLE_TEE && !NON_OS_BUILD
    esp_tee_intr_sec_srv_cb(2, SS_RV_UTILS_INTR_ENABLE, intr_mask);
#else
    // Disable all interrupts to make updating of the interrupt mask atomic.
    unsigned old_mstatus = RV_CLEAR_CSR(mstatus, MSTATUS_MIE);
    esprv_int_enable(intr_mask);
    RV_SET_CSR(mstatus, old_mstatus & MSTATUS_MIE);
#endif
}

FORCE_INLINE_ATTR void rv_utils_intr_disable(uint32_t intr_mask)
{
#if CONFIG_SECURE_ENABLE_TEE && !NON_OS_BUILD
    esp_tee_intr_sec_srv_cb(2, SS_RV_UTILS_INTR_DISABLE, intr_mask);
#else
    // Disable all interrupts to make updating of the interrupt mask atomic.
    unsigned old_mstatus = RV_CLEAR_CSR(mstatus, MSTATUS_MIE);
    esprv_int_disable(intr_mask);
    RV_SET_CSR(mstatus, old_mstatus & MSTATUS_MIE);
#endif
}

FORCE_INLINE_ATTR void rv_utils_intr_global_enable(void)
{
#if CONFIG_SECURE_ENABLE_TEE && !NON_OS_BUILD
    esp_tee_intr_sec_srv_cb(1, SS_RV_UTILS_INTR_GLOBAL_ENABLE);
#else
    RV_SET_CSR(mstatus, MSTATUS_MIE);
#endif
}

FORCE_INLINE_ATTR void rv_utils_intr_global_disable(void)
{
#if CONFIG_SECURE_ENABLE_TEE
    if (IS_PRV_M_MODE()) {
        RV_CLEAR_CSR(mstatus, MSTATUS_MIE);
    } else {
        RV_CLEAR_CSR(ustatus, USTATUS_UIE);
    }
#else
    RV_CLEAR_CSR(mstatus, MSTATUS_MIE);
#endif
}

/**
 * @brief Checks whether the given interrupt number is reserved either in the given mask or in the
 *        _mtvt_table, which contains the routines the CPU will jump to when an interrupt or an exception
 *        occurs, on RISC-V targets.
 *
 * @param intr_num  External interrupt number to check, in range 0~32
 * @param rsvd_mask Reserved interrupt mask, where bit i is 1 if interrupt i is reserved.
 *
 * @returns ESP_CPU_INTR_DESC_FLAG_RESVD if the interrupt is reserved, 0 else
 */
static inline uint32_t esp_riscv_intr_num_flags(int intr_num, uint32_t rsvd_mask)
{
    if (rsvd_mask & BIT(intr_num)) {
        return ESP_CPU_INTR_DESC_FLAG_RESVD;
    }

    extern intptr_t _mtvt_table[48];
    extern intptr_t _interrupt_handler;

    /* The first 16 entries of the array are internal interrupt, ignore them  */
    const intptr_t destination = _mtvt_table[16 + intr_num];

    return (destination != (intptr_t)&_interrupt_handler) ? ESP_CPU_INTR_DESC_FLAG_RESVD : 0;
}



#else // !SOC_INT_CLIC_SUPPORTED

#include "esp_cpu.h"
#include "riscv/instruction_decode.h"

/**
 * @brief Checks whether the given interrupt number is reserved either in the given mask or in the
 *        _vector_table, which contains the routines the CPU will jump to when an interrupt or an exception
 *        occurs, on RISC-V targets.
 *
 * @param intr_num  Interrupt number to check, in range 0~32
 * @param rsvd_mask Reserved interrupt mask, where bit i is 1 if interrupt i is reserved.
 *
 * @returns ESP_CPU_INTR_DESC_FLAG_RESVD if the interrupt is reserved, 0 else
 */
static inline uint32_t esp_riscv_intr_num_flags(int intr_num, uint32_t rsvd_mask)
{
    if (rsvd_mask & BIT(intr_num)) {
        return ESP_CPU_INTR_DESC_FLAG_RESVD;
    }

    extern intptr_t _vector_table[32];
    extern int _interrupt_handler;
    const intptr_t pc = (intptr_t) &_vector_table[intr_num];

    /* JAL instructions are relative to the PC they are executed from. */
    const intptr_t destination = pc + riscv_decode_offset_from_jal_instruction(pc);

    return (destination != (intptr_t)&_interrupt_handler) ? ESP_CPU_INTR_DESC_FLAG_RESVD : 0;
}

#endif // SOC_INT_CLIC_SUPPORTED

#endif // CONFIG_IDF_TARGET_ARCH_RISCV

    fs/fat: Restore the no-short-name marker when the name will not shorten.
    
    fat_path2dirname() marks a parsed name as needing long file name
    entries by clearing the first byte of the short name buffer, and
    fat_dirnamewrite() writes the long name entries only while that marker
    survives.  Since commit bc9e1ffb01, a name short enough to fit the 8.3
    form is speculatively re-parsed as a short name, and the re-parse
    fills the short name buffer with spaces before it examines a single
    character.  When it then rejects the name (lower case, for example) the
    spaces stay behind, the marker is gone, and the file is created with
    eleven spaces for a name: no long name entries, a blank alias.
    
    Every such file aliases to every other, since every rejected name
    converts to the same blank entry.  Create a.txt, then create big1, and
    both names now open one file; a directory of them lists as a single
    nameless entry.  Any application that writes two lowercase short-named
    files and reads the first back gets the second's contents.
    
    Restore the marker when the speculative parse fails.
    
    Tested on FAT32 with CONFIG_FAT_LFN: lower case, upper case, mixed
    case and over-length names now create distinct, correctly named
    entries that survive unmount and reboot; upper case 8.3 names still

+
+#include "esp_attr.h"
+#include "esp_bit_defs.h"
+#include "esp_cpu.h"
+#include "esp_rom_sys.h"
+#include "riscv/interrupt.h"
+#include "soc/soc.h"
+
+#if SOC_INT_CLIC_SUPPORTED
+#  include "hal/interrupt_clic_ll.h"
+#  include "esp_private/interrupt_clic.h"
+#endif // SOC_INT_CLIC_SUPPORTED
+
+#include "esp_private/vectors_const.h"
+
+#ifndef CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ESP32C3
+#  include "soc/hp_system_reg.h"
+#endif
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Pre-processor Definitions
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+#ifdef CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS
+#  define ESP_NCPUS                     CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS
+#else
+#  define ESP_NCPUS                     1
+#endif
+
+#ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE_DYNAMIC
+#  ifndef CONFIG_ARCH_IRQ_TO_NDX
+#    error "CONFIG_ARCH_IRQ_TO_NDX must be enabled for RISC-V-based \
+            Espressif SoCs. Run 'make menuconfig' to select it."
+#  endif
+#  if CONFIG_ARCH_NUSER_INTERRUPTS != 17
+#    error "CONFIG_ARCH_NUSER_INTERRUPTS must be 17 for RISC-V-based \
+            Espressif SoCs. Run 'make menuconfig' to set it."
+#  endif
+#else
+#  error "CONFIG_ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE_DYNAMIC must be enabled for \
+          RISC-V-based Espressif SoCs. Additionally, enable \
+          CONFIG_ARCH_IRQ_TO_NDX and set CONFIG_ARCH_NUSER_INTERRUPTS to 17.\
+          Run 'make menuconfig' to select and set these options."
+#endif
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Private Function Prototypes
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+static void esp_clear_handle(int cpu, int irq);
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Private Data
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+/* Map an IRQ to a handle to which the interrupt source is attached to. */
+
+static volatile intr_handle_t g_handle_map[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS][NR_IRQS];
+
+#ifdef CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_IRAM_ISR_DEBUG
+/* The g_iram_count keeps track of how many times such an IRQ ran when the
+ * non-IRAM interrupts were disabled.
+ */
+
+static uint64_t g_iram_count[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS][NR_IRQS];
+#endif
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Public Data
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Private Functions
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: esp_cpuint_initialize
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Initialize CPU interrupts.
+ *
+ * Input Parameters:
+ *   None.
+ *
+ * Returned Value:
+ *   None.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+static void esp_cpuint_initialize(void)
+{
+  /* Set CPU interrupt threshold level */
+
+  esprv_int_set_threshold(RVHAL_INTR_ENABLE_THRESH);
+  rv_utils_intr_global_enable();
+}
+
+#ifdef CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_IRAM_ISR_DEBUG
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name:  esp_iram_interrupt_record
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   This function keeps track of the IRQs that ran when non-IRAM interrupts
+ *   are disabled and enables debugging of the IRAM-enabled interrupts.
+ *
+ * Input Parameters:
+ *   irq - The IRQ associated with a CPU interrupt
+ *   cpu - The CPU associated with the CPU interrupt
+ *
+ * Returned Value:
+ *   None.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+IRAM_ATTR static void esp_irq_iram_interrupt_record(int irq, int cpu)
+{
+  irqstate_t flags = enter_critical_section();
+
+  g_iram_count[cpu][irq]++;
+
+  leave_critical_section(flags);
+}
+#endif
+
+IRAM_ATTR static void isr_adapter_func(void *arg)
+{
+  struct intr_adapter_from_nuttx *isr_adapter_args;
+
+  isr_adapter_args = (struct intr_adapter_from_nuttx *)arg;
+
+  isr_adapter_args->func(isr_adapter_args->irq,
+                         isr_adapter_args->context,
+                         isr_adapter_args->arg);
+}
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: esp_isr_demultiplexing
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Demultiplexing interrupt handler. All peripheral interrupts are
+ *   dispatched through this single handler, which then calls the
+ *   appropriate peripheral handler registered via esp_setup_irq.
+ *
+ * Input Parameters:
+ *   irq     - The IRQ number (XTENSA_IRQ_DEMUX)
+ *   context - Saved processor state
+ *   arg     - Unused
+ *
+ * Returned Value:
+ *   Always returns OK.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+IRAM_ATTR static int esp_isr_demultiplexing(int irq, void *context,
+                                            void *arg)
+{
+  int cpuint = esp_get_cpuint(this_cpu(), irq);
+  intr_handler_t handler;
+  struct intr_adapter_from_nuttx *handler_arg;
+
+  /* Validate cpuint - if invalid, the interrupt was not properly
+   * registered via esp_setup_irq. This is a bug that needs to be fixed.
+   */
+
+  if (cpuint < 0 || cpuint >= SOC_CPU_INTR_NUM)
+    {
+      irqwarn("IRQ %d has invalid cpuint=%d (not registered)", irq, cpuint);
+      return OK;
+    }
+
+  handler = (intr_handler_t)esp_cpu_intr_get_handler(cpuint);
+  handler_arg = (struct intr_adapter_from_nuttx *)
+                  esp_cpu_intr_get_handler_arg(cpuint);
+
+  /* If the handler is the isr_adapter_func, then we need to set the irq
+   * and context to the handler_arg. This is true for all interrupts set via
+   * esp_setup_irq. Exceptions are the interrupts set directly by the
+   * underlying hardware, like Wi-Fi.
+   */
+
+  if (handler == &isr_adapter_func)
+    {
+      handler_arg->irq = irq;
+      handler_arg->context = context;
+    }
+
+  if (handler)
+    {
+      (*handler)(handler_arg);
+    }
+  else
+    {
+      /* Handler not found in _xt_interrupt_table.
+       * This happens when irq_attach was used instead of esp_setup_irq
+       * with a non-NULL handler. Peripheral handlers must be set via
+       * esp_setup_irq() when using ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE.
+       */
+
+      irqwarn("No handler for irq=%d cpuint=%d\n", irq, cpuint);
+    }
+
+  return OK;
+}
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Public Functions
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: up_irq_to_ndx
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Irq to ndx
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+int IRAM_ATTR up_irq_to_ndx(int irq)
+{
+  return irq < ESP_IRQ_FIRSTPERIPH ? irq : ESP_IRQ_DEMUX;
+}
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: up_irqinitialize
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Complete initialization of the interrupt system and enable normal,
+ *   interrupt processing.
+ *
+ * Input Parameters:
+ *   None.
+ *
+ * Returned Value:
+ *   None.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+void up_irqinitialize(void)
+{
+  int i;
+  int j;
+
+  /* Indicate that no interrupt sources are assigned to CPU interrupts */
+
+  for (i = 0; i < NR_IRQS; i++)
+    {
+      for (j = 0; j < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; j++)
+        {
+          g_handle_map[j][i] = IRQ_UNMAPPED;
+        }
+    }
+
+  /* Initialize CPU interrupts */
+
+  esp_cpuint_initialize();
+
+  /* Initialize GPIO interrupt support */
+
+#ifdef CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_GPIO_IRQ
+  esp_gpioirqinitialize();
+#endif
+
+  /* Initialize RTCIO interrupt support */
+
+  esp_rtcioirqinitialize();
+
+  /* Attach the common interrupt handler */
+
+  riscv_exception_attach();
+
+#ifndef CONFIG_SUPPRESS_INTERRUPTS
+
+  irq_attach(ESP_IRQ_DEMUX, esp_isr_demultiplexing, NULL);
+
+  /* And finally, enable interrupts */
+
+  riscv_color_intstack();
+  up_irq_enable();
+#endif
+}
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: up_enable_irq
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Enable the interrupt specified by 'irq'.
+ *
+ * Input Parameters:
+ *   irq           - IRQ number.
+ *
+ * Returned Value:
+ *   None.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+void up_enable_irq(int irq)
+{
+  esp_err_t ret;
+  intr_handle_t intr_handle = esp_get_handle(this_cpu(), irq);
+
+  if (intr_handle == IRQ_UNMAPPED)
+    {
+      irqwarn("IRQ %d not mapped to handle\n", irq);
+      return;
+    }
+
+  ret = esp_intr_enable(intr_handle);
+  if (ret != ESP_OK)
+    {
+      irqerr("Failed to enable interrupt %d\n", irq);
+    }
+}
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: up_disable_irq
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Disable the interrupt specified by 'irq'.
+ *
+ * Input Parameters:
+ *   irq           - IRQ number.
+ *
+ * Returned Value:
+ *   None.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+void up_disable_irq(int irq)
+{
+  esp_err_t ret;
+  intr_handle_t intr_handle = esp_get_handle(this_cpu(), irq);
+
+  ret = esp_intr_disable(intr_handle);
+  if (ret != ESP_OK)
+    {
+      irqerr("Failed to disable interrupt %d\n", irq);
+    }
+}

   249	/****************************************************************************
   250	 * Name: uart_interrupt
   251	 *
   252	 * Description:
   253	 *   This is the UART interrupt handler. It will be invoked when an
   254	 *   interrupt is received on the 'irq'. It should call uart_xmitchars or
   255	 *   uart_recvchars to perform the appropriate data transfers. The
   256	 *   interrupt handling logic must be able to map the 'irq' number into the
   257	 *   appropriate uart_dev_s structure in order to call these functions.
   258	 *
   259	 * Input Parameters:
   260	 *   irq           - IRQ associated to that interrupt.
   261	 *   context       - Interrupt register state save info.
   262	 *   arg           - A pointer to the argument provided when the interrupt
   263	 *                   was registered.
   264	 *
   265	 * Returned Value:
   266	 *   Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
   267	 *
   268	 ****************************************************************************/
   269	
   270	static int uart_handler(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
   271	{
   272	  uart_dev_t *dev = (uart_dev_t *)arg;
   273	  struct esp_uart_s *priv = dev->priv;
   274	  uint32_t tx_mask = UART_INTR_TXFIFO_EMPTY | UART_INTR_TX_DONE;
   275	  uint32_t rx_mask = UART_INTR_RXFIFO_TOUT | UART_INTR_RXFIFO_FULL;
   276	  uint32_t int_status = uart_hal_get_intsts_mask(priv->hal);
   277	
   278	  /* Tx fifo empty interrupt or UART tx done int */
   279	
   280	  if ((int_status & tx_mask) != 0)
   281	    {
   282	      uart_xmitchars(dev);
   283	      uart_hal_clr_intsts_mask(priv->hal, tx_mask);
   284	    }
   285	
   286	  /* Rx fifo timeout interrupt or rx fifo full interrupt */
   287	
   288	  if ((int_status & rx_mask) != 0)
   289	    {
   290	      uart_recvchars(dev);
   291	      uart_hal_clr_intsts_mask(priv->hal, rx_mask);
   292	    }
   293	
   294	  return OK;
   295	}

只读审计结论：当前 IRQ/timer 修复已达到最小闭环，没有发现还必须修改的 UART 代码。

必须保留的行为：

- P4 `mcause` 使用 reason mask，并减去 `RV_EXTERNAL_INT_OFFSET=16`。
- CLIC 阈值使用 `RVHAL_INTR_ENABLE_THRESH=0`，否则优先级 1 会被屏蔽。
- systimer 使用 P4 的 LEVEL source 与 RCC 初始化。
- LEVEL 中断执行 `CLIC_INT_IP` ack。
- P4 systimer clear 后轮询 `int_st`，确认外设 level source 已撤销。

实板矩阵已经证明最后两项缺一不可。poll 已限定在 P4 systimer，没有被错误泛化。相关文件没有残留 trace，`git diff --check` 通过。

UART0 同样配置为 LEVEL，因此通用 LEVEL ack 必须保留。现有 ISR 会：

- RX：清空硬件 FIFO，再 W1C 清 RX status。
- TX：填充 FIFO，发送缓冲为空时关闭 TX IRQ，再清 TX status。

没有静态证据要求给 UART 再增加 poll/fence。剩余风险用实板覆盖即可：

1. 慢速逐字输入 `help` 后回车，覆盖 RX timeout。
2. 快速粘贴超过 120 字节，覆盖 RX FIFO full。
3. 连续执行 `help`，覆盖 TX FIFO empty。
4. 随后间隔约 1 秒执行两次 `uptime`。

当前 `CONFIG_NSH_LINELEN=80`，长粘贴允许截断或报行过长；验收标准是系统不冻结、prompt 能恢复、`uptime` 持续递增。上述测试重复数轮通过后，可认为最小 NSH 范围内 UART RX/TX 风险已排除，无需继续扩改。

 uint64_t esp_gpio_reserve(uint64_t gpio_mask)
 {
+#ifdef __NuttX__
+    irqstate_t flags = enter_critical_section();
+    uint64_t old_mask = s_reserved_pin_mask;
+    s_reserved_pin_mask |= gpio_mask;
+    leave_critical_section(flags);
+    return old_mask;
+#else
     return atomic_fetch_or(&s_reserved_pin_mask, gpio_mask);
+#endif
 }
 
 uint64_t esp_gpio_revoke(uint64_t gpio_mask)
 {
+#ifdef __NuttX__
+    irqstate_t flags = enter_critical_section();
+    uint64_t old_mask = s_reserved_pin_mask;
+    s_reserved_pin_mask &= ~gpio_mask;
+    leave_critical_section(flags);
+    return old_mask;
+#else
     return atomic_fetch_and(&s_reserved_pin_mask, ~gpio_mask);
+#endif
 }
 
 bool esp_gpio_is_reserved(uint64_t gpio_mask)
 {
+#ifdef __NuttX__
+    irqstate_t flags = enter_critical_section();
+    bool reserved = (s_reserved_pin_mask & gpio_mask) != 0;

# Here are the requirements for a NuttX PR

## Summary

  * Why change is necessary (fix, update, new feature)?
  * What functional part of the code is being changed?
  * How does the change exactly work (what will change and how)?
  * Related NuttX Issue reference if applicable.
  * Related NuttX Apps Issue / Pull Request reference if applicable.

## Impact

  * Is new feature added? Is existing feature changed?
  * Impact on user (will user need to adapt to change)? NO / YES (please describe if yes).
  * Impact on build (will build process change)? NO / YES (please descibe if yes).
  * Impact on hardware (will arch(s) / board(s) / driver(s) change)? NO / YES (please describe if yes).
  * Impact on documentation (is update required / provided)? NO / YES (please describe if yes).
  * Impact on security (any sort of implications)? NO / YES (please describe if yes).
  * Impact on compatibility (backward/forward/interoperability)? NO / YES (please describe if yes).
  * Anything else to consider?

## Testing

I confirm that changes are verified on local setup and works as intended:

  * Build Host(s): OS (Linux,BSD,macOS,Windows,..), CPU(Intel,AMD,ARM), compiler(GCC,CLANG,version), etc.
  * Target(s): arch(sim,RISC-V,ARM,..), board:config, etc.

L173: ## Summary
L174: 
L175: This pull request series significantly enhances the ARM64 Memory Protection Unit (MPU) infrastructure across four incremental commits:
L176:   1. Explicit naming: Rename MPU attribute macros to clearly indicate access permissions (REGION_RAM_ATTR → REGION_RW_NA_ATTR, etc.)
L177:   2. Unified interface: Refactor MPU configuration functions to use consistent parameters across all architectures
L178:   3. Code simplification: Consolidate macro definitions to eliminate duplication while preserving functionality
L179:   4. Platform optimization: Extract board-specific MPU initialization for FVP and improve memory layout flexibility
L180: These changes improve code clarity, ensure consistency across ARM64 variants (including Cortex-R82), reduce maintenance burden, and enhance platform-specific flexibility.
L181: ## Changes
L182: 
L183: Commit 1: Rename MPU attribute macros (61 lines)
L184:   * Rename `REGION_RAM_ATTR` → `REGION_RW_NA_ATTR` (Kernel Read/Write, User No Access)
L185:   * Rename `REGION_URAM_ATTR` → `REGION_RW_RW_ATTR` (Kernel & User Read/Write)
L186:   * Rename `REGION_RAM_TEXT_ATTR` → `REGION_KTEXT_ATTR` (Kernel Text)
L187:   * Rename `REGION_RAM_UTEXT_ATTR` → `REGION_UTEXT_ATTR` (User Text)
L188:   * Add `REGION_RO_RO_ATTR` for read-only regions accessible to all
L189:   * Add `REGION_RO_NA_ATTR` for kernel read-only, user no access regions
L190:   * Update boot code to use new macro names
L191:   * Files: arm64_mpu.h, fvp_boot.c (2 files, +41, -20)
L192: Commit 2: Unify MPU interface (73 lines)
L193: 
L194:   * Change `mpu_modify_region(region, table)` → `mpu_modify_region(region, base, size, flags1, flags2)`
L195:   * Change `mpu_configure_region(table)` → `mpu_configure_region(base, size, flags1, flags2)`
L196:   * Direct parameter interface eliminates struct dependency
L197:   * Ensures consistency across all ARM64 MPU variants
L198:   * Update all callers in boot code
L199:   * Files: arm64_mpu.c, arm64_mpu.h, fvp_boot.c (3 files, +42, -31)
L200: 
L201: Commit 3: Simplify macro definitions (125 lines)
L202:   * Introduce unified `SHAREABLE_MSK` macro:
L203:     * CONFIG_SMP: `SHAREABLE_MSK = INNER_SHAREABLE_MSK`
L204:     * CONFIG_UP: `SHAREABLE_MSK = NON_SHAREABLE_MSK`
L205:   * Consolidate duplicated CONFIG_SMP/CONFIG_UP macro blocks
L206:   * Replace individual REGION_*_ATTR definitions with unified versions
L207:   * Result: 83 lines removed, 42 lines added (net -41 lines)
L208:   * Files: arm64_mpu.h (1 file, +42, -83)
L209: 
L210: Commit 4: Optimize FVP MPU configuration (420 lines)
L211:   * Extract arm64_mpu_init_regiions() function for board-specific initialization
L212:   * Remove hardcoded MPU region loop from arm64_mpu_init()
L213:   * Refactor FVP memory layout to minimize fixed region requirements
L214:   * Create fvp_userspace.c for platform-specific MPU initialization
L215:   * Update build system and linker scripts for improved memory flexibility
L216:   * Files: arm64_mpu.c, arm64_mpu.h, Make.defs, fvp_boot.c, fvp_userspace.c, memory.ld, nuttx_user.ld (12 files, +287, -133)
L217: Total Changes: ~600 net lines, comprehensive MPU infrastructure enhancement
L218: ## Impact
L219:   * Clarity: Explicit permission semantics in macro names (RW_NA, RO_RO, etc.)
L220:   * Consistency: Same interface across Cortex-A72, Cortex-R82, and other ARM64 variants
L221:   * Maintainability: Reduced macro duplication and configuration complexity
L222:   * Code reduction: 41 net lines removed through consolidation
L223:   * Platform flexibility: Board-specific MPU initialization enables custom memory layouts
L224:   * Extensibility: Easier to add new attribute combinations and board variants
L225:   * Protected mode: Improved support for user/kernel space separation in FVP

L144: arch/risc-v/espressif: Update common-source integration for RISC-V devices
L145: This commit updates the common-source integration for RISC-V-based Espressif devices (ESP32-C3, ESP32-C6, and ESP32-H2). This is part of a larger common-source update split by architecture for better maintainability of the already-supported devices and upcoming devices.
L146: Major components updated: - IRQ allocator refactoring with intr_alloc integration - Common-source drivers (GPIO, RMT, I2C, SPI, UART, etc.) - Espressif components upgrade to release/master.b - Peripheral drivers (ADC, PWM, LEDC, MCPWM, PCNT, Temperature Sensor, etc.) - Wireless adapters (Wi-Fi and BLE) - Board defconfigs for all RISC-V Espressif boards - Critical section handling improvements Key architectural changes: - IRQ Allocator: The new interrupt allocator enables multiple mapping options from interrupt sources to CPU interrupts, providing flexibility required by modern peripherals.
L147: Although this introduces breaking changes to the interrupt handling API, the required ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE Kconfig option is explicitly checked during startup to ensure proper configuration. This validation prevents runtime issues from configuration mismatches. Note: This is a large commit to maintain bisectability. Breaking the changes into smaller commits would result in non-building intermediate states across the common-source infrastructure update.
L148: Tested configurations: - All defconfigs were built and tested, inclusing `ostest`. Signed-off-by: Tiago Medicci Serrano <tiago.medicci@espressif.com> To be merged with RISC-V implementation

L145: This commit updates the common-source integration for RISC-V-based Espressif devices (ESP32-C3, ESP32-C6, and ESP32-H2). This is part of a larger common-source update split by architecture for better maintainability of the already-supported devices and upcoming devices.
L146: Major components updated: - IRQ allocator refactoring with intr_alloc integration - Common-source drivers (GPIO, RMT, I2C, SPI, UART, etc.) - Espressif components upgrade to release/master.b - Peripheral drivers (ADC, PWM, LEDC, MCPWM, PCNT, Temperature Sensor, etc.) - Wireless adapters (Wi-Fi and BLE) - Board defconfigs for all RISC-V Espressif boards - Critical section handling improvements Key architectural changes: - IRQ Allocator: The new interrupt allocator enables multiple mapping options from interrupt sources to CPU interrupts, providing flexibility required by modern peripherals.
L147: Although this introduces breaking changes to the interrupt handling API, the required ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE Kconfig option is explicitly checked during startup to ensure proper configuration. This validation prevents runtime issues from configuration mismatches. Note: This is a large commit to maintain bisectability. Breaking the changes into smaller commits would result in non-building intermediate states across the common-source infrastructure update.
L148: Tested configurations: - All defconfigs were built and tested, inclusing `ostest`. Signed-off-by: Tiago Medicci Serrano <tiago.medicci@espressif.com> To be merged with RISC-V implementation

Apache NuttX is a real-time operating system (RTOS) with an emphasis on standards compliance and small footprint. Scalable from 8-bit to 64-bit microcontroller environments, the primary governing standards in NuttX are POSIX and ANSI standards. Additional standard APIs from Unix and other common RTOSs (such as VxWorks) are adopted for functionality not available under these standards, or for functionality that is not appropriate for deeply-embedded environments (such as fork()).

For brevity, many parts of the documentation will refer to Apache NuttX as simply NuttX.

## Getting Started

+/*
+ * SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2022-2023 Espressif Systems (Shanghai) CO LTD
+ *
+ * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+ */
+
+#include "esp_rom_caps.h"
+#include "soc/clic_reg.h"
+#include "riscv/interrupt.h"
+
+#if ESP_ROM_CLIC_INT_TYPE_PATCH
+
+/* Rom api esprv_intc_int_set_type, if the configured interrupt type is INTR_TYPE_EDGE,
+ * the actual configured type is still INTR_TYPE_LEVEL. So the patch is to solve this issue.
+ * Since esprv_intc_int_set_type has an alias defined as esprv_int_set_type in riscv/ld/rom.api.ld,
+ * therefore, use esprv_int_set_type to override the rom function.
+ */
+void esprv_int_set_type(int rv_int_num, enum intr_type type)
+{
+    REG_SET_FIELD(CLIC_INT_CTRL_REG(rv_int_num + CLIC_EXT_INTR_NUM_OFFSET), CLIC_INT_ATTR_TRIG, type);
+}
+#endif

    44	 * Name: up_initial_state
    45	 *
    46	 * Description:
    47	 *   A new thread is being started and a new TCB
    48	 *   has been created. This function is called to initialize
    49	 *   the processor specific portions of the new TCB.
    50	 *
    51	 *   This function must setup the initial architecture registers
    52	 *   and/or  stack so that execution will begin at tcb->start
    53	 *   on the next context switch.
    54	 *
    55	 ****************************************************************************/
    56	
    57	void up_initial_state(struct tcb_s *tcb)
    58	{
    59	  struct xcptcontext *xcp = &tcb->xcp;
    60	#if defined(CONFIG_ARCH_RV_ISA_V) && (CONFIG_ARCH_RV_VECTOR_BYTE_LENGTH == 0)
    61	  uintptr_t *vregs = tcb->vregs;
    62	#endif
    63	  uintptr_t regval;
    64	  uintptr_t topstack;
    65	#ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_KERNEL_STACK
    66	  uintptr_t *kstack = xcp->kstack;
    67	#endif
    68	
    69	  /* Initialize the initial exception register context structure */
    70	
    71	  memset(xcp, 0, sizeof(struct xcptcontext));
    72	
    73	#if defined(CONFIG_ARCH_RV_ISA_V) && (CONFIG_ARCH_RV_VECTOR_BYTE_LENGTH == 0)
    74	
    75	  /* Initialize vector registers */
    76	
    77	  if (vregs == NULL)
    78	    {
    79	      regval = READ_CSR(CSR_VLENB);
    80	      if (regval != 0)
    81	        {
    82	          /* There are 32 vector registers(v0 - v31) with vlenb length. */
    83	
    84	          xcp->vregs = kmm_calloc(1, regval * 32 + VPU_XCPT_SIZE);
    85	          DEBUGASSERT(xcp->vregs != NULL);
    86	        }
    87	    }
    88	  else
    89	    {
    90	      /* Keep the vector region if task restart */
    91	
    92	      xcp->vregs = vregs;
    93	    }
    94	#endif
    95	
    96	  /* Initialize the idle thread stack */
    97	
    98	  if (tcb->pid == IDLE_PROCESS_ID)
    99	    {
   100	      tcb->stack_alloc_ptr = (void *)g_cpux_idlestack(this_cpu());
   101	      tcb->stack_base_ptr  = tcb->stack_alloc_ptr;
   102	      tcb->adj_stack_size  = SMP_IDLE_STACK_SIZE;
   103

   106

   109	      xcp->sstack_top_ptr = (uintreg_t *)((uintptr_t)xcp->sstack_alloc_ptr +
   110	                                          SMP_SHADOW_STACK_SIZE);
   111	#endif /* CONFIG_ARCH_RV_SHADOW_STACK */
   112	
   113	#ifdef CONFIG_STACK_COLORATION
   114	      /* If stack debug is enabled, then fill the stack with a
   115	       * recognizable value that we can use later to test for high
   116	       * water marks.
   117	       */
   118	
   119	      riscv_stack_color(tcb->stack_alloc_ptr, 0);

   124	      riscv_set_idleintctx();

   126	    }

   137	      topstack     = (uintptr_t)kstack + ARCH_KERNEL_STACKSIZE;
   138	      xcp->ktopstk = (uintptr_t *)topstack;
   139	      xcp->kstkptr = xcp->ktopstk;
   140	    }
   141	#endif
   142	
   143	  xcp->regs = (uintreg_t *)(topstack - XCPTCONTEXT_SIZE);
   144	  memset(xcp->regs, 0, XCPTCONTEXT_SIZE);
   145	
   146	  /* Save the initial stack pointer.  Hmmm.. the stack is set to the very
   147	   * beginning of the stack region.  Some functions may want to store data on
   148	   * the caller's stack and it might be good to reserve some space.  However,
   149	   * only the start function would do that and we have control over that one
   150	   */
   151	
   152	  xcp->regs[REG_SP]      = topstack;
   153	
   154	  /* Save the task entry point */
   155	
   156	  xcp->regs[REG_EPC]     = (uintptr_t)tcb->start;
   157	
   158	  /* Setup thread local storage pointer */
   159

   162	                                     sizeof(struct tls_info_s);
   163	#endif
   164	
   165	  /* Set the initial value of the interrupt context register.
   166	   *
   167	   * Since various RISC-V platforms use different interrupt
   168	   * methodologies, the value of the interrupt context is
   169	   * part specific.
   170	   *
   171	   */

   184	#endif

   187	  tcb->xcp.initregs = tcb->xcp.regs;
   188	#endif
   189	}

     4	
     5	本文档面向「新硬件适配赛道」的开发者，目标是帮助开发者在自己的开发板上**先启动到 NSH 命令行提示符**。建议的工作流是：先以本文给出的最小集启动，验证串口与 NSH 工作正常后，再按需逐步打开文件系统、网络、传感器等子系统。

     7	## 一、概述
     8	
     9	### 1、文档目标
    10	
    11	参赛者拿到一块尚未适配 openvela 的开发板后，最关键的第一步是让系统能启动到 NSH 命令行提示符。本文档提供一份**最小**的 defconfig 参考，仅包含启动 NSH 所必需的配置项，便于参赛者：
    12	
    13	- 快速判断哪些 CONFIG **必须修改**（与目标硬件强相关）；
    14	- 哪些 CONFIG **可直接复用**（与硬件无关的运行时支持）；
    15	- 完成 L0 启动后，按子系统顺序**增量启用**功能。
    16	
    17	### 2、推荐工作流
    18	
    19	```
    20	Step 0: 硬件就绪
    21	        - 目标芯片在 nuttx/arch/<arch>/src/<chip>/ 下已有支持
    22	        - 板级目录已建立 (boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/)
    23	        - 串口 TX/RX 引脚与上位机连通
    24	        ↓
    25	Step 1: 套用本文最小集 → 编译 → 烧录 → 串口看到 NSH 提示符
    26	        ↓
    27	Step 2: 按硬件能力增量启用子系统
    28	        - 文件系统 (FAT / LittleFS)
    29	        - 网络协议栈 (Ethernet / Wi-Fi)
    30	        - 图形 (LCD / framebuffer / LVGL)
    31	        - 传感 (uORB / I2C / SPI sensors)
    32	        ↓
    33	Step 3: 移植稳定后做 release 瘦身
    34	        - 关闭 DEBUG_*、ALLSYMS 等调试项
    35	        - 调整 stack size 至实测需求
    36	```
    37	
    38	## 二、最小 NSH 必需配置
    39	
    40	本节配置项参考 `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32/nucleo-f303re/configs/nsh/defconfig`（35 行）整理而来，并参考了 Mateusz Szafoni 的 [NuttX small systems 系列文章](https://www.railab.me/tags/small-systems/) 对最小化裁剪的实践经验。
    41	
    42	### 1、架构与板级标识（必须按目标硬件替换）
    43	
    44	```
    45	CONFIG_ARCH="arm"
    46	CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP="stm32"
    47	CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32=y
    48	CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32F303RE=y
    49	CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="nucleo-f303re"
    50	CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_NUCLEO_F303RE=y
    51	```
    52	
    53	#### 替换原则
    54	
    55	| 配置项 | 替换原则 |
    56	| ---- | ---- |
    57	| `CONFIG_ARCH=` | 目标 CPU 架构，例如 `"arm"`、`"arm64"`、`"risc-v"`、`"xtensa"` |
    58	| `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP=` 与 `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_<FAMILY>=y` | 目标 SoC 家族，需与 `nuttx/arch/<arch>/src/<chip>/` 目录一致（如 `stm32`、`stm32h7`、`nrf52`、`esp32s3`） |
    59	| `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_<DEVICE>=y` | 具体型号，例如 `STM32F407VG`、`NRF52840`、`ESP32S3` |
    60	| `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD=` 与 `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_<NAME>=y` | 板级目录名，需与 `nuttx/boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/` 一致 |
    61	
    62	### 2、内存布局（必须按目标硬件填写）
    63	
    64	```
    65	CONFIG_RAM_START=0x20000000
    66	CONFIG_RAM_SIZE=65536
    67	CONFIG_MM_REGIONS=2
    68	CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC=6522
    69	```
    70	
    71	#### 配置项说明
    72	
    73	- `CONFIG_RAM_START`：主 SRAM 起始物理地址，参考目标芯片 datasheet（多数 ARM Cortex-M 为 `0x20000000`）。
    74	- `CONFIG_RAM_SIZE`：主 SRAM 容量，单位字节。
    75	- `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS`：堆管理器管理的内存区域数量。当芯片存在多块不连续 SRAM（如 STM32F4 的 CCM、STM32H7 的 AXI/AHB SRAM）时需调整为对应数量。
    76	- `CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC`：忙等延时校准值，与 CPU 频率相关，可先填一个估算值，启动后通过 `up_mdelay()` 校准。
    77	
    78	### 3、串口控制台（必须按目标硬件替换）
    79	
    80	```
    81	CONFIG_STM32_USART2=y
    82	CONFIG_USART2_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y
    83	CONFIG_STM32_JTAG_SW_ENABLE=y
    84	```
    85	
    86	#### 替换原则
    87	
    88	| 配置项 | 替换原则 |
    89	| ---- | ---- |
    90	| `CONFIG_<CHIP>_USART<N>=y` | 启用目标芯片对应 UART 外设。STM32 用 `STM32_USARTx`，nRF52 用 `NRF52_UART0`，ESP32 用 `ESP32_UART0` |
    91	| `CONFIG_USART<N>_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y` | 指定该 UART 作为系统控制台 |
    92	| `CONFIG_<CHIP>_JTAG_SW_ENABLE=y` | 视目标芯片可选，用于保留 SWD 调试口 |
    93	
    94	参赛者可参考 `nuttx/boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/include/board.h` 中的引脚定义，确认串口对应的物理 TX/RX 引脚与电路板设计一致。
    95	
    96	### 4、NSH Shell 启动入口（直接复用）
    97	
    98	```
    99	CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y
   100	CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"
   101	```
   102	
   103	#### 配置项说明
   104	
   105	- `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y`：将 NSH 编译为系统应用。
   106	- `CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"`：将 NSH 设为系统启动后的首个用户态任务，串口接通后即进入命令行提示符。
   107	
   108	### 5、调度与运行时支持（直接复用）
   109	
   110	```
   111	CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200
   112	CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y
   113	CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4
   114	CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048
   115	CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0
   116	CONFIG_START_DAY=27
   117	CONFIG_START_YEAR=2013
   118	```
   119	
   120	#### 配置项说明
   121	
   122	- `CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200`：轮转调度时间片为 200 ms。
   123	- `CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y`：启用 `waitpid()` 系统调用，NSH 在执行内置命令时依赖此特性。
   124	- `CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4`：预分配 4 个 POSIX 定时器，满足基础需求。
   125	- `CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048`：idle 线程栈大小，2 KB 适用于多数 Cortex-M 板。RAM 紧张时可下调至 1024。
   126	- `CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0`：禁用任务名称字符串以节省 RAM。如需 `ps` 命令显示任务名，可设为 16~32。
   127	- `CONFIG_START_DAY` 与 `CONFIG_START_YEAR`：系统启动时的初始日期，可任意填写。
   128	
   129	### 6、调试与诊断（强烈建议保留）
   130	
   131	```
   132	CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y
   133	CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y
   134	CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y
   135	CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y
   136	```
   137	
   138	#### 配置项说明
   139	
   140	- `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y`：保留调试符号，便于使用 GDB 单步调试与 backtrace 分析。
   141	- `CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y`：系统出现 hardfault 时输出栈内容，移植阶段是定位问题的重要手段。
   142	- `CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y` 与 `CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y`：编译后同时产出 `.hex` 与 `.bin` 两种烧录格式。
   143	
   144	### 7、CPU 特性裁剪（按需调整）
   145	
   146	```
   147	# CONFIG_ARCH_FPU is not set
   148	```
   149	
   150	#### 说明
   151	
   152	`CONFIG_ARCH_FPU` 控制硬件浮点单元的启用。Cortex-M4F、M7 等带 FPU 的内核如需使用浮点运算，应改为 `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y`。Cortex-M0/M3 无 FPU，保持注释状态即可。
   153	
   154	### 8、板级辅助（可选）
   155	
   156	```
   157	CONFIG_ARCH_BUTTONS=y
   158	```
   159	
   160	#### 说明
   161	
   162	`CONFIG_ARCH_BUTTONS=y`：当板上存在 USER 按钮时启用按钮驱动框架。如目标板无按键，可省略。
   163	
   164	## 三、可直接复用的 defconfig 片段
   165	
   166	下列 16 项配置与硬件无关，可在任何 ARM Cortex-M 板上原样使用：
   167	
   168	```
   169	CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200
   170	CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y
   171	CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4
   172	CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048
   173	CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0
   174	CONFIG_START_DAY=27
   175	CONFIG_START_YEAR=2013
   176	CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y
   177	CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"
   178	CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y
   179	CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y
   180	CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y
   181	CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y
   182	```
   183	
   184	参赛者只需根据自己的硬件填写第二节中标注「必须按目标硬件替换」的部分（架构标识、内存布局、串口配置），即可形成完整的 L0 defconfig。

   207	## 五、增量启用子系统
   208	
   209	L0 启动成功（串口看到 NSH 提示符）后，可按目标板的硬件能力逐步启用子系统。各类子系统的常用 CONFIG 起点如下：
   210	
   211	| 子系统 | 主要 CONFIG 起点 |
   212	| ---- | ---- |
   213	| 文件系统（FAT、LittleFS、PROCFS） | `CONFIG_FS_FAT`、`CONFIG_FS_LITTLEFS`、`CONFIG_FS_PROCFS` |
   214	| 网络协议栈（TCP/IP、Wi-Fi） | `CONFIG_NET`、`CONFIG_NET_TCP`、`CONFIG_NET_UDP` |
   215	| 图形与显示（fb、LCD、LVGL） | `CONFIG_VIDEO_FB`、`CONFIG_GRAPHICS_LVGL` |
   216	| 传感与 uORB | `CONFIG_SENSORS`、`CONFIG_UORB` |
   217	| 蓝牙（BLE） | `CONFIG_BLUETOOTH`、`CONFIG_NIMBLE` |
   218	| 音频 | `CONFIG_AUDIO` |
   219	| 电源管理 | `CONFIG_PM` |

   223	## 六、功能验证
   224	
   225	子系统启用后，建议通过标准化测试用例验证目标硬件上各子系统的功能完整性。openvela 社区维护了一份面向社区开发者的 xTS 测试用例精简集，覆盖了外设驱动、文件系统、网络、媒体等多个子系统，可作为子系统启用后的功能验收手段。
   226	
   227	### 1、推荐使用方式
   228	
   229	- **L0 启动验证**：参赛者按本文最小集完成 NSH 启动后，通过串口手动输入命令（如 `help`、`uname`、`ps`）验证基础 shell 与系统调用工作正常。
   230	- **子系统功能验证**：每启用一个子系统后，从 xTS 测试集中选取该子系统对应的用例运行（如启用 SPI/I2C 驱动后跑 SPI_I2C 测试）。
   231	- **回归验证**：移植稳定后，将整套 xTS 用例作为回归测试集，便于后续配置变更后的功能确认。
   232	
   233	### 2、xTS 测试集覆盖范围
   234	
   235	| 测试主题 | 适用场景 |
   236	| ---- | ---- |
   237	| SPI / I2C 驱动 | 外设驱动启用后验证总线通信（含 BMI160 传感器示例） |
   238	| Ymodem 文件传输 | 串口文件传输能力验证 |
   239	| mediatool 媒体测试 | 音视频编解码与播放链路验证 |
   240	| WiFi 兼容性 | 已适配路由器列表与连接稳定性验证 |
   241	| 自测试框架（cmocka） | 编写自定义单元测试时的框架使用方法 |
   242	
   243	详细的测试步骤、测试资源与依赖配置请参考 [openvela 社区开发者 xTS 测试用例精简集](../../../test_dev_guide/openvela_xts_test_cases.md) 与 [openvela 自测试框架使用指南](../../../test_dev_guide/openvela_testcase_dev_guide.md)。
   244	
   245	## 七、新硬件适配 Checklist
   246	
   247	参赛者完成 BSP 移植后，建议按以下清单检查 defconfig 完整性与目标硬件兼容性：
   248	
   249	- [ ] `CONFIG_ARCH`、`CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP`、`CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD` 三项已替换为目标硬件标识
   250	- [ ] `CONFIG_RAM_START` 与 `CONFIG_RAM_SIZE` 已按目标芯片 datasheet 填写
   251	- [ ] 多 SRAM 区芯片（如 STM32F4 含 CCM）已正确设置 `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS`
   252	- [ ] 串口外设宏（如 `CONFIG_STM32_USART2=y`）已切换至目标芯片对应 UART
   253	- [ ] `CONFIG_USART<N>_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y` 与 `board.h` 中的引脚定义一致
   254	- [ ] 串口波特率默认为 115200，与上位机终端一致
   255	- [ ] `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y` 与 `CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"` 已启用
   256	- [ ] `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y` 与 `CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y` 已启用，便于排查启动问题
   257	- [ ] 带 FPU 的内核（M4F/M7）已启用 `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y`，无 FPU 的内核（M0/M3）保持关闭
   258	- [ ] `CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC` 已根据 CPU 频率设置初始估算值
   259	
   260	通过 Checklist 后即可执行 `./build.sh <vendor>:<config> -j` 编译。烧录后，串口接通并出现 `nsh> ` 提示符即代表 L0 启动成功。
